# Reference

## Contents

- Tolerance matrix

## Tolerance matrix

Tolerance varies by spend category because commodity volatility differs sharply between
them. Freight and energy carry wider bands than stationery or professional services, since
their underlying indices move weekly rather than annually.

| Category | Price tolerance | Quantity tolerance |
|---|---|---|
| Freight | 6.0% | 2 units |
| Energy | 8.0% | 0 units |
| Professional services | 1.0% | 0 units |
| Stationery | 2.0% | 5 units |

## Tax jurisdictions

Reverse-charge treatment applies where the supplier and recipient sit in different member
states and both hold valid registration numbers. Domestic supplies attract the standard
rate unless the commodity appears on the reduced-rate schedule.

Import duty, where the consignment originates outside the customs union, is reconciled
against the broker's declaration rather than the supplier invoice — the two documents
routinely disagree on landed cost.

## Escalation windows

Unresolved variances age into progressively senior queues: seven days to the buyer,
fourteen to the category manager, twenty-one to the finance business partner. The clock
starts at variance detection, not invoice receipt, so a slow extraction does not consume
the buyer's response window.
